== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Trainer Mura is an instructor responsible for training individuals such as Trainee [[Orthos]]. Her duties include managing daily routines, teaching trainees about the history of the [[Wolf Division]] and general knowledge regarding the [[Abidan]], and guiding students on how to connect their physical movements to Way{{!}}the Way. She monitors progress toward [[advancement]] levels and facilitates practice sessions between trainees, such as [[Akura Pride]]. Beyond her instructional role, Mura has been observed performing rescue work by clearing debris to assist injured people. She also manages the equalization process for trainees within her training environment.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Trainer Mura is a powerful woman of tall stature. She possesses dark purple hair.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a trainer, she utilizes [[Presence]] to provide guidance to her students. She is currently engaged in the act of rescuing individuals from wreckage.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She can fold possibilities into existence to create temporary copies of herself. Additionally, she uses [[Presence]] as a method to guide others.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Trainer Mura is a tall, powerful woman distinguished by her dark purple hair. As a trainer who utilizes [[Presence]] to guide her students, she works to rescue individuals from amidst wreckage. During these efforts, she utilizes temporary copies of herself that are folded into existence from various possibilities. While these duplicates assist her, only her original body requires sustenance.}}
